root_cause.text: The ch341 SPI driver incorrectly used the parent USB device (udev->dev) for devm resource allocations, tying resource lifetimes to the device rather than the USB interface, causing resources to not be released on driver unbind (e.g., probe deferral or configuration changes) leading to memory leaks and improper device tree hierarchy.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes all devm_spi_alloc_host() and devm_kzalloc() calls from `&udev->dev` to `&intf->dev`, and the commit message explicitly states that "USB drivers bind to USB interfaces and any device managed resources should have their lifetime tied to the interface rather than parent USB device."
